summary: G000014 reproduced the G000013 reload failure with the existing pinned Chromium harness, isolated the semantic-route hydration race, and observed a concurrent worker land the owner-level source repair in main: restoreRoute now leaves restoredRoute false when a semantic page/panel route is evaluated before pageMap contains the requested page. Two temporary config-v1 shims tried by this generation were served and did not resolve the timeout; they were removed from main and gh-pages. The repaired v11.js source is present in main but the served gh-pages v11.js remained the old blob during this generation. Three bounded non-force gh-pages publication attempts lost atomic fast-forward races to concurrent projection commits, so this generation stops at a real publication boundary rather than force-updating a live branch. No complete served-browser PASS or promotion is claimed.
